data.title: 黍 · 下班回家先问你饿不饿
data.description: 夕阳下的住宅门前，黍还穿原作白色露肩外套与纹样长裤，手中提着装有蔬菜的布袋。她侧过脸微笑看你，空着的一只手扶住门，像是在问晚饭想吃什么；衣摆和龙尾自然避开门槛。
data.action: 提着菜袋扶门，侧脸看向镜头询问晚饭
data.mood: 回家时轻松而自然的关心
data.promptProse: Shu pauses in the open residence doorway, vegetables in a cloth bag at one side while her free hand holds the door. She smiles sideways toward her companion. Show her full figure at eye level in the original white off-shoulder jacket and patterned trousers, with both the garment hem and dragon tail clear of the threshold. The outer door jamb frames her near shoulder; floorboards continue behind her into the quieter entry hall. Low sunset reaches the outer sleeve, the bag folds and the step. Warm light from inside spills across the inner door edge and floor, leaving a soft shadow directly below the bag and her boots.
